Yes — that reads clearly. Searching "saturn" gave me "No bookmarks found — nothing in your library matches 'saturn', try another word or clear the search." So I understand the search actually ran and simply didn't find anything, rather than something being broken or my library having vanished. Repeating my word back to me is a nice touch — it reassures me it looked for the right thing.

And "Clear search" is the right way out. When I've drawn a blank, the natural next move is either to try a different word or to back out and see everything again, and that button gives me the second one in a single click. Good handling of the empty case.
